reviews.title: Close AS3 Areas 2-5 Vector.sort, native reflection, E4X operators and drawWithQuality gaps
reviews.summary: Adds RETURNINDEXEDARRAY and UNIQUESORT to Vector.sort(), extends getQualifiedClassName, getQualifiedSuperclassName and describeType across native Flash display/runtime classes and interfaces, completes E4X computed qualifiers, dynamic XML/XMLList access/writes and indexed/descendant delete, and applies StageQuality supersampling and linearGamma on DisplayObject drawWithQuality.

entries.note: Supports custom comparators and Array sort flags including CASEINSENSITIVE, DESCENDING, NUMERIC, UNIQUESORT (returning 0 without mutating on duplicates), and RETURNINDEXEDARRAY (returning a sorted index Array without mutating).
Returns Adobe qualified names across AS3 project classes, primitives, Vector.<T>, interfaces, and native Flash display and runtime classes and instances.
Resolves full Adobe superclass chains across AS3 project classes, native Flash display and runtime hierarchies, primitives, and interfaces (returning null for Object, interfaces, null, and void).

Produces Flash XML type descriptions with extendsClass, implementsInterface, accessor, method, variable, and factory metadata for AS3 project classes, native Flash display/runtime classes and instances, Vector.<T>, and interfaces.
Supports compiled xml.@attr, xml.@[expr], xml.@*, standalone @attr in E4X filters and with scopes, and dynamic @attr Proxy property reads, writes, membership checks, and deletion.
Supports descendant reads, standalone ..tag in E4X filters and with scopes, direct descendant element and attribute replacement (xml..tag = ..., xml..@attr = ...), and descendant deletion.
Supports static ns::name, *::name, and computed (nsExpr)::name, (nsExpr)::[nameExpr], (nsExpr)::*, @(nsExpr)::attr, and ..(nsExpr)::tag qualifiers.
Supports named child, attribute, computed @[expr], indexed XMLList (delete xml.item[0]), no-op XML self-index (delete xml[0]), descendant (delete xml..tag), and Proxy deleteProperty deletion.
Supports compiled E4X child access/assignment and dynamic Proxy get, set, has, and deleteProperty on XML and single-item XMLList instances (throwing TypeError #1089 on multi-item XMLList writes).

Applies StageQuality supersampling (LOW through HIGH_16X16), StageQuality child-bitmap smoothing rules, and premultiplied linearGamma box downsampling for both DisplayObject and BitmapData sources, rejecting BlendMode.SHADER with ArgumentError.
